tasks.goal: Port and verify the pinned Cordis Context, service registry, event modes, effect ownership, dependency injection, fiber activation, rollback, and quiescent disposal contract. Treat Loader and Include as optional consumers, not prerequisites of the Cordis core. This task is the single owner of the lifecycle change and ALL necessary boot/harness/CLI/HMR/diagnostics consumer adaptations. Follow .goose/cordis-lifecycle-contract.md. Preserve the retained round-six combined checkpoint, including its 49 modified files and existing event-order assertions; do not reimplement completed cases. Do not defer required consumer await/settlement changes to a separate task. Existing tests are not authority for loop-less synchronous activation: if retaining that adaptation, request a source-backed judge verdict. First inspect the combined checkpoint and run focused lifecycle tests, then close remaining concrete gaps. Full original Cordis acceptance remains required. Absorb the old activation-microtask-deferral proposal and readiness invariant source mapping into this owner; classify any genuinely Loader/Include composition-only cases with their existing owner and evidence, without deferring Cordis clauses. Judge arbitration (round seven) reconciled the conflicting proposals into this single owner: (1) preserve ordinary effect owner visibility until asynchronous cleanup settles (reference/vendor/cordis/src/fiber.ts:485-520) instead of retiring the wrapper before cleanup; (2) publish startup failure as LOADING -> UNLOADING -> FAILED while still unloading the effects collected before failure, removing the premature FAILED publication; (3) settle every Loader Entry/EntryGroup initialization, update, dependent fiber activation and teardown task before tree, boot, harness, CLI or HMR settlement returns. The proposed separate vendor/cordis-loader-settlement node is absorbed here, as the judge directed. The loop-less inline activation branch (python38-no-ambient-checkpoint) and the caller-driven awaitable disposal tail are permitted Python 3.8 adaptations; in-loop activation keeps the upstream deferral, cancellation and epoch-invalidation window.

contracts.description: An ordinary effect remains listed by its owner while asynchronous cleanup is in flight, repeated disposal joins the same cleanup, and wrapper/metadata retirement occurs only after settlement.

Startup failure records the error, invalidates the epoch, unloads collected effects, emits LOADING -> UNLOADING -> FAILED, and rethrows from await only after cleanup settles; explicit disposal does not repeat cleanup.
Every Loader Entry/EntryGroup initialization, update, fiber activation, and teardown task has an owner and is awaited before tree, boot, harness, CLI, or HMR settlement returns.
